record.question: Which is not an absolute indication for dialysis in AKI?
record.explanation: Answer D: Creatinine 3 mmol/L. Dialysis initiation is based on symptoms, signs, quality of life, GFR and laboratory abnormalities; a creatinine concentration alone is not an absolute indication. Refractory hyperkalemia, refractory volume overload and uremic encephalopathy are recognized urgent indications. Reference: https://kdigo.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/KDIGO-2026-AKI-AKD-Guideline-Public-Review-Draft-March-2026.pdf; https://kdigo.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/KDIGO-2024-CKD-Guideline-Executive-Summary.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
